title: From second moments to pairwise negative correlation: applications to minimal and uniform spanning trees
summary: We uncover a close connection between the second moment of the degree of a typical vertex in a random subgraph and the pairwise negative correlation (p-NC) property. On one hand, we exploit this connection to prove the p-NC property for non-adjacent edges in minimal spanning trees on complete graphs.
